'''Static pulse adaptors''' were an integral part of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon, located in the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. Blasters usually had a variable number of static pulse adaptor modules. [[Blaster pistol/Legends|Blaster pistols]] generally had four, while [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]] had six. Spare static pulse adaptor modules were included in [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[Blaster Repair Kit]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
